column1: # Actions of the command palette (prefix + Ctrl+K), read by command-palette.sh.
# One action per line, three fields separated by a TAB: label, key hint (empty when there is none), tmux command.
# The tmux command runs as if typed at prefix + :, on the pane, window and session that opened the palette.
# Lines starting with # are comments. Adding an action = adding one line.
